segments.title: Sea power and the Welsh castle ring
segments.summary: A planned study asks how sea power shaped the Welsh castle ring and whether a similar logic could guide the siting of bases in science fiction.
segments.body: The planned programme examines the maritime reasoning behind the ring of stone castles used to try to pacify Wales. It asks how the realities of the sea affected castle design, with a proposed account reaching back to Roman times and following the idea forward. A science-fiction comparison asks whether bases are better placed on moons, other large satellites, or asteroids than on a planet's surface. The announcement raises these questions without yet explaining the reasons for those choices.

evidence.note: Clarke announces a study of the maritime reasoning behind the castle ring used to try to pacify Wales, tracing the idea back to Roman times and posing a science-fiction question about base locations. The explanation is promised for a later programme.
